author: Inside Edition
description: A two-ton Hypercar made almost entirely of plastic Lego bricks recently was assembled by engineers at the toy company's headquarters in Denmark. But this performance automobile is no toy; itcan hit speeds of up to nearly 70 miles an hour. Christian Von Koenigsegg, CEO of Koenigsegg Automotive AB, told reporters "creating one of the most extreme LEGO models in history is really a great honor for us."
title: Hypercar Made of Lego Bricks Hits 69 Miles Per Hour
